question: The part of the Himalayan mountains that is lying between Tista and Dihang river is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam Himalayas**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Assam Himalayas** are the section of the Himalayan mountain range
 
• It is located between the **Tista River** in the west and the **Dihang River** (also known as the Siang River or Tsangpo in Tibet) in the east.
 
• This region lies primarily in the eastern Himalayas, covering parts of **Arunachal Pradesh** and **eastern Bhutan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64de6b92583bb1470bbd8c7a070de4e11e0f0e8d8ba7a9075a9f15dff34c14c1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Punjab Himalayas**:
 
• This section of the Himalayas extends from the **Indus River** in the west to the **Sutlej River** in the east.
 
• It covers areas in Jammu and Kashmir, as well as parts of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• **Kumaon Himalayas**:
 
• The Kumaon Himalayas lie between the **Sutlej River** in the west and the **Kali River** in the east.
 
• This region primarily covers the **Uttarakhand** state in India.
 
• **Kashmir & Himachal Himalayas**:
 
• This section of the Himalayas lies between the **Indus** and **Sutlej Rivers** and covers the regions of **Jammu and Kashmir** and **Himachal Pradesh**.
